source.target: x86-64 Linux, Wasmtime API, opt_level=speed_and_size, generate_address_map=true

native_positive_case.semantics: unsigned-i64 quotient XOR rol64(unsigned-i64 remainder,17); zero divisor traps

independent_archive_audit.method: Downloaded exact CI artifact and SHA-256 validated against GitHub digest; reopened both compiler binaries and AOT objects, rehashed all against qualification and guest-metadata receipts, rehashed same WAT, probe and auditor; independently parsed both disassemblies to count x86 opcode bytes/instructions/divs; checked guest trap/value equivalence and source offsets; extracted both exact Wasmtime/AOT binaries and re-executed ten values and five zero-divisor cases per compiler on a separate x86-64 Linux container.
independent_archive_audit.separate_local_reexecution_qualifier: CLI stderr 'wasm trap: integer divide by zero' and original-Wasm backtrace 0x28; API classification and offsets were checked by CI Rust probe, not rerun independently with a separate Rust build
independent_archive_audit.x86_instruction_byte_recount: baseline 43 bytes/16 instructions/2 divisions; patched 25 bytes/10 instructions/1 division

limitations: This establishes finite guest-visible Wasmtime API Trap classification and original-Wasm backtrace offsets for the same direct WAT fixture, not proof of internal compiled trap-table entries, native fault PCs or all source locations.
Compiler optimizer SSA/liveness/flags, poison/UB, register allocation, all target assumptions and full compiler-pass safety have not been proved.
The patched compiler is in a disposable checkout; no Bytecode Alliance upstream branch was modified.
The same-WAT x86-64 per-function static cost reduction does not imply whole-AOT savings, runtime throughput or representative workload profitability.
This is a human-authored experimental dual-result udivrem pass, not a new instruction sequence discovered through ZenoFCIS search.
The previously demonstrated narrow ZenoFCIS search, semantic-check and receipt catalog readiness is separate from upstream production-readiness of this candidate.
next: Qualify correct internal Wasmtime trap maps and compiler-pass SSA/regalloc safety across effectful contexts; then evaluate representative workloads before any upstream submission.
